evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna says 'it might take about ten to fifteen minutes' and mentions getting a quotation, but does not explicitly frame 'you can walk away with a quote you can depend on' or wait for a clear yes before pivoting to 'do you have any important concerns about this move'—the wait and confirmation are missing.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after probing started: 'do you have any important concerns about this move that you also want to discuss on this call aside from the pricing?' is asked very early, but Joanna immediately begins logistics probing with 'the address were coming from is 1550 Blalock road' before confirming the customer's answer to the agenda question.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer says 'No' to concerns, so no follow-up needed; N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Customer raised no concerns, so no reflection required; N/A applies.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (apartment), floor/stories (second floor), number of rooms (two bedroom), walking distance (parking directly in front, drop-off ~100 feet, door near stairs), additional rooms (none mentioned but probed), special considerations (disassembled in one room), additional stops (none). All seven items covered or confirmed.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: 'Do you need help with packing or everything's already packed. Good to go.' — asked and declined.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: 'For the boxes. How many are we looking at? Do you think you'll go over 2030 boxes?' — asked, customer answers 'less than ten.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Anchor given: 'typically two bedroom apartment usually takes three and a half to five and a half hours to complete. But in your case...I'm just gonna estimate it more on the three to four hour mark.' Personalized to customer's move: 'everything's already packed and good to go' and minimal items (bed frames, mattresses, sofa, table, chairs, few boxes). Three price points: $475 (minimum), $570 (3 hours), $760 (4 hours).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Fee transparency: 'all inclusive rates, like everything we need is already in that price, taxes, insurance, credit card fees, fuel transportation fees. We don't charge for the stairs as well.' Commitment framing: 'two and a half hour minimum. Once we go over the minimum, we only charge in fifteen minute intervals. So we don't charge you for the full hour right away.' Both present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Joanna moves directly to 'Okay.' and does not ask 'Does that feel fair?' or equivalent, nor does she hold silence for the customer to respond.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: 'Lastly on time guarantee if we run late on the time, we schedule, we provide discounts for your move again.' — delivered with discount terms (discounts if late) in recognizable form.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: 'we will also include our no worries, damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any repair, replacement reimbursement for any accidental damages.' — covers $2,000 and built-in framing, but does NOT explicitly state 'no deductible / no fine print.' Partial.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Joanna does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent after covering the Two Promises. No close-the-loop confirmation present.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Never asked. Call ends without a genuine 'What's still concerning you?' or even a throwaway 'any questions?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' before closing.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked. Joanna never says 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any recognizable version. Call ends after the estimate discussion without an ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking happens. No date, phone number, arrival window, crew size, or addresses confirmed. Call ends without capturing next steps or confirming any details.

top_strength: Joanna gathered all seven logistics details efficiently and personalized the estimate precisely to this customer's small, pre-packed move, resulting in a clear three-tier price range ($475–$760) that reflects the customer's actual situation rather than a generic two-bedroom estimate.
coaching_note: The call ends abruptly after pricing without asking 'Does that feel fair?', never checking for remaining concerns, and crucially never asking for the business—Joanna must close with the explicit ask ('Would you like our help?'), confirm booking details (date, phone, addresses, crew size), and leave notes for the crew, or no sale is possible.
